title: Catalogue Ordering Terms and Delivery Charges by Card Tier
content:
A member of a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme may spend the allowance by ordering from the plan's printed catalogue. The order minimum, the delivery charges and the times quoted are terms of the tier.

| Card tier | Catalogue ordering | Smallest order processed | Standard delivery charge | Expedited delivery charge | Business days to despatch | Business days for standard delivery once despatched | Business days for expedited delivery once despatched | Hours to cancel without a charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | available | 10.00 USD | 4.95 USD | 14.95 USD | 2 | 7 | 3 | 24 |
| Select | available | 10.00 USD | 3.95 USD | 12.95 USD | 2 | 6 | 3 | 24 |
| Plus | available | 8.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 9.95 USD | 1 | 5 | 2 | 24 |
| Premier | available | 8.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 7.95 USD | 1 | 5 | 2 | 48 |
| Dual Complete | available | 5.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 5.95 USD | 1 | 4 | 2 | 48 |
| Chronic Care Plus | available | 5.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 5.95 USD | 1 | 4 | 2 | 48 |

Catalogue ordering is available on all six tiers of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes.

Worked delivery times, on hypothetical figures. A Plus order despatched after 1 business day and carried 5 business days by the standard service is quoted at 6 business days in all; the same order sent by the expedited service is quoted at 3 business days in all and carries a delivery charge of 9.95 USD. Where a tier makes no charge for standard delivery, the figure in that column is 0.00 USD and only the expedited service is charged for.
